scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.lint: eslint app/src app/tests app/e2e-fixtures backend/src backend/scripts test scripts *.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: eslint app/src app/tests app/e2e-fixtures backend/src backend/scripts test scripts *.config.ts --fix
scripts.test:python: if [ -x .venv-aws-test/bin/python ]; then .venv-aws-test/bin/python -m unittest discover -s backend/test -p 'test_*.py'; else python3 -m unittest discover -s backend/test -p 'test_*.py'; fi
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:backend:e2e && npm run test:frontend:playwright
scripts.test:prod: npm run test:all && npm run check:prod:readiness
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:frontend:unit && npm run build
scripts.verify:backend: npm --prefix backend run check && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test:all: npm run test:frontend:unit && npm run test:backend:unit && npm run test:e2e:all && npm run test:python
scripts.format:check: prettier --check app/src app/tests app/e2e-fixtures backend/src backend/scripts test scripts infra .github/workflows docs/PHASE_1_BASELINE.md docs/architecture/inventory.md test/TEST_SUITE_INDEX.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json backend/package.json backend/tsconfig.json
scripts.format: prettier --write app/src app/tests app/e2e-fixtures backend/src backend/scripts test scripts infra .github/workflows docs/PHASE_1_BASELINE.md docs/architecture/inventory.md test/TEST_SUITE_INDEX.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json backend/package.json backend/tsconfig.json
